description: The same type-name matrix as ddl-type-names-accdb on a writable Jet 4 (MDB) copy, so that ACCDB and MDB acceptance and the DAO Field Type, Size and Attributes can be compared. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-mdb is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
